title: Lawrence Brown's record Charlie's Idea
summary: Brown's early record of Tiger Rag as Charlie's Idea with Paul Howard's band showed a trombone speed nobody had heard.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And then Lawrence, you see, Lawrence made a record that nobody knew about way back there, I think about 1930, * actually 'Memories of You'; Song of the Islands, made earlier * get Hamp!
called 'Charlie's Idea.' It was really 'Tiger Rag.' Nobody ever heard a trombone player like that. Nobody knew who he was or anything because nobody ever went to California. But --
'Charlie's -- It was what they called Charlie's Idea of Tiger Rag,' really, is what it was. It was 'Tiger Rag.'
Do you know what band he played it with?
I don't know -- oh, Paul Howard.
Paul Howard was the name of the band, that's right.
